activity_context.topic_title: Sums of Finite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation

feedback.worked_solution:
Since the given series is in the form ${\sum }_{n=1}^{N}a{r}^{n},$ it is a geometric series. 

To determine the sum, we use the formula for the sum ${S}_{N}$ of a geometric series.

$$
{S}_{N}={a}_{1}\frac{(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}
$$

In this case, $r=5$ and $N=4.$ We need to figure out the value of ${a}_{1}.$

The formula for the $n$th term of the series is

$$
{a}_{n}=4(5)^{n},
$$

and therefore we can calculate the first term ${a}_{1}$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =4(5)^{1}=20\end{aligned}
$$

If we substitute ${a}_{1}=20,r=5$ and $N=4$ into the formula for ${S}_{N}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{n=1}^{4}4(5)^{n} & =20\cdot \frac{(1-{5}^{4})}{1-5} \\  & =-\frac{20}{4}(-624) \\  & =-5(-624) \\  & =3\,120\end{aligned}
$$
